# ascii-magic-art (vendored)

Five files of the npm package `ascii-magic-art`, version 1.1.0, copied here unchanged:
the player (`runtime/`), the toolkit it needs (`lib/kit.js`) and one piece
(`pieces/viaduct-steam-train.js`). The contact sheet plays that piece
(`src/components/ContactScene.astro`).

- Source: https://github.com/kailashsr38/ascii-magic-art
- Licence: MIT, see `LICENSE`. The site serves the same text at `/licenses/ascii-magic-art.txt`.
- The package's two photo scenes under the Unsplash licence are not included.

To update or add a piece, copy the files again from the same version of the package; do not edit them here.
